title: Women's Chunky Platform Sneakers in Faux Leather
description:
Lace-up trainers on a chunky but lightweight sole that adds about 5 cm of height. The smooth faux-leather upper wipes clean and goes with jeans, dresses and joggers alike.
• Upper: faux leather (PU) with mesh panels; lining: textile
• Removable padded insole
• Platform height 5 cm; EVA and rubber outsole
• Colour: sand beige; sizes EU 36–41 (between sizes, choose the larger)
